Running Python code interactively: # Let me analyze the original testcase more carefully
import struct

with open('/workspace/original_testcase.gz', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# Gzip header: 1f 8b 08 ... 
# The header is 10 bytes minimum, plus optional fields
# Let me parse it

# Gzip header
magic = data[0:2]
cm = data[2]  # compression method
flags = data[3]  # flags
mtime = struct.unpack('<I', data[4:8])[0]
xfl = data[8]
os = data[9]

print(f"Magic: {magic.hex()}")
print(f"CM: {cm}")
print(f"Flags: {flags:08b}")
print(f"MTIME: {mtime}")
print(f"XFL: {xfl}")
print(f"OS: {os}")

# Check flags
header_len = 10
if flags & 0x01:  # FTEXT
    print("FTEXT flag set")
if flags & 0x02:  # FHCRC
    print("FHCRC flag set")
    # 2 bytes CRC
    header_len += 2
if flags & 0x04:  # FEXTRA
    xlen = struct.unpack('<H', data[header_len:header_len+2])[0]
    print(f"FEXTRA flag set, XLEN: {xlen}")
    header_len += 2 + xlen
if flags & 0x08:  # FNAME
    print("FNAME flag set")
    # null-terminated string
    end = data.index(b'\x00', header_len)
    fname = data[header_len:end]
    print(f"Filename: {fname}")
    header_len = end + 1
if flags & 0x10:  # FCOMMENT
    print("FCOMMENT flag set")
    end = data.index(b'\x00', header_len)
    fcomment = data[header_len:end]
    print(f"Comment: {fcomment}")
    header_len = end + 1
if flags & 0x02:  # FHCRC (already handled above)
    pass

print(f"Header length: {header_len}")
print(f"Total data length: {len(data)}")

# Deflate data starts at header_len, ends at -8 (footer)
deflate_data = data[header_len:-8]
print(f"Deflate data length: {len(deflate_data)}")
print(f"Deflate data hex: {deflate_data.hex()}")

# Footer
crc32 = struct.unpack('<I', data[-8:-4])[0]
isize = struct.unpack('<I', data[-4:])[0]
print(f"CRC32: {crc32:08x}")
print(f"ISIZE: {isize}")

# Try to decompress with Python
import zlib
try:
    decompressed = zlib.decompress(deflate_data, -zlib.MAX_WBITS)
    print(f"Decompressed ({len(decompressed)} bytes): {decompressed[:100]}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Decompress error: {e}")
